select COUNT(*) as total, COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) as amount,
            SUM(CASE WHEN queue_status='unprepared' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unprepared,
            SUM(CASE WHEN queue_status='needs_review' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as needs_review,
            SUM(CASE WHEN queue_status='prepared' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as prepared,
            SUM(CASE WHEN queue_status IN ('queued','sending','retry') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as queued,
            SUM(CASE WHEN queue_status='accepted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as accepted,
            SUM(CASE WHEN queue_status IN ('rejected','uncertain','dead_letter') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as attention from (select `d`.*, NULL as outbox_id,NULL as document_hash,NULL as blockers,NULL as prepared_at,NULL as preparation_status,NULL as job_id,NULL as delivery_state,NULL as attempts,NULL as provider_reference,NULL as last_error,NULL as available_at,NULL as completed_at,'unprepared' as queue_status from (select `amount` from `ledger_documents` force index (ledger_eis_summary) where `is_draft` = ? and `document_source` in (?, ?) and `identity_rank` = ?) as `d`) as `c` limit 1

select index_name as `name`, group_concat(column_name order by seq_in_index) as `columns`, index_type as `type`, not non_unique as `unique` from information_schema.statistics where table_schema = schema() and table_name = 'ledger_documents' group by index_name, index_type, non_unique

select * from (select `d`.*, NULL as outbox_id,NULL as document_hash,NULL as blockers,NULL as prepared_at,NULL as preparation_status,NULL as job_id,NULL as delivery_state,NULL as attempts,NULL as provider_reference,NULL as last_error,NULL as available_at,NULL as completed_at,'unprepared' as queue_status from (select * from `ledger_documents` where `is_draft` = ? and `document_source` in (?, ?) and `identity_rank` = ?) as `d`) as `c` where `id` in (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

select column_name as `name`, data_type as `type_name`, column_type as `type`, collation_name as `collation`, is_nullable as `nullable`, column_default as `default`, column_comment as `comment`, generation_expression as `expression`, extra as `extra` from information_schema.columns where table_schema = schema() and table_name = 'ledger_documents' order by ordinal_position asc

select `id` from (select `d`.*, NULL as outbox_id,NULL as document_hash,NULL as blockers,NULL as prepared_at,NULL as preparation_status,NULL as job_id,NULL as delivery_state,NULL as attempts,NULL as provider_reference,NULL as last_error,NULL as available_at,NULL as completed_at,'unprepared' as queue_status from (select * from `ledger_documents` where `is_draft` = ? and `document_source` in (?, ?) and `identity_rank` = ?) as `d`) as `c` order by `business_date` desc, `id` desc limit 25 offset 0

select column_name as `name`, data_type as `type_name`, column_type as `type`, collation_name as `collation`, is_nullable as `nullable`, column_default as `default`, column_comment as `comment`, generation_expression as `expression`, extra as `extra` from information_schema.columns where table_schema = schema() and table_name = 'ledger_documents' order by ordinal_position asc
select exists (select 1 from information_schema.tables where table_schema = schema() and table_name = 'ledger_dirty_documents' and table_type in ('BASE TABLE', 'SYSTEM VERSIONED')) as `exists`
